name: Southfury Moonstone
shortDescription: The stone used in the attempt to call Anzu at the Raven’s Claw; the illustration is interpretive research art.
body: The stone used in the attempt to call Anzu at the Raven’s Claw; the illustration is interpretive research art. The original research illustration is interpretive, not canonical model evidence; compare it with the relevant TBC client before approval.
